import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd()
def wr(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
r=json.loads((L/'reservation.json').read_text());o=json.loads((L/'original-objects.json').read_text());results=json.loads((L/'results.json').read_text());assert set(results)==set(map(str,r['ids'])) and len(o)==20
for z in o:
 v=json.loads(z['raw']); assert hashlib.sha256(z['raw'].encode()).hexdigest()==z['raw_sha256']; assert z['raw'].endswith('\n');assert hashlib.sha256(z['statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==z['statement_token_sha256'];assert json.loads(z['statement_token'])==v['statement']==z['statement'];assert hashlib.sha256(z['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==z['statement_utf8_sha256'];assert (L/'originals'/f"{v['mathdb_id']}.jsonl").read_bytes()==z['raw'].encode()
prev='0'*64; events=[]
for raw in (L/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 z=json.loads(raw);assert z['previous']==prev and z['seq']==len(events);prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest();events.append(z)
for z in events:
 if z['event']=='success': assert hashlib.sha256((L/z['destination']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==z['sha256']
b=json.loads((L/'search-budget.json').read_text());charges=[json.loads(x) for x in (L/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert b['calls_used']==len(charges)==3 and b['queries_used']==sum(len(z['queries']) for z in charges)==9
for z in charges:assert hashlib.sha256((L/z['plan']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==z['plan_sha256']
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(L.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 z=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'file':p.name,'exit':z['exit'],'killed':z['killed'],'wall_s':z['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':z['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':z['child_cpu_cumulative_s'],'affinity':z['affinity'],'cpu_limit_s':z['cpu_limit_s'],'as_limit_bytes':z['as_limit_bytes']})
wr('resource-inventory.json',json.dumps({'completed_receipts_before_this_invocation':receipts,'limits':'Actual immutable run.py, no universal transient/native/writer measurement','later_receipts':'audit_handoff and manifest-finalize remain separately recorded; frozen-after standalone exception'},indent=2))
wr('provenance-audit.json',json.dumps({'originals':20,'receipt_files_before_this':len(receipts),'hashchain_records':len(events),'http_attempts':sum(x['event']=='attempt' for x in events),'successes':sum(x['event']=='success' for x in events),'new_unavailable':sum(x['event']=='unavailable' for x in events),'search_calls':3,'search_queries':9,'history_allowed_reads':len(json.loads((L/'history-access.json').read_text())),'qualified_survivors':0,'independent_passes':0,'accepted_credit':0},indent=2))
print('Provenance, hashchain, twenty bindings, budget continuity audited; no mathematical acceptance')
